exposure: nonobstetric surgery under general or regional anesthesia during pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women with and without nonobstetric surgery during pregnancy (n=118,851)
finding: Nonobstetric surgery during pregnancy was associated with a higher risk of spontaneous abortion, adverse delivery outcomes, cesarean section, and prolonged hospital stay.
mod_finding: Nonobstetric surgery during gestation was associated with a higher risk of cesarean section.
